cards.stem: What machine directs the cycling process of PCR?
cards.quote: It is directed by a machine called a thermocycler

cards.stem: Which enzyme builds new DNA strands using original strands as templates?
cards.quote: Next, an enzyme called "Taq polymerase" synthesizes - builds - two new strands of DNA, using the original strands as templates.

cards.stem: Which laboratory technique uses amplified DNA to identify samples?
cards.quote: including DNA fingerprinting, detection of bacteria or viruses (particularly AIDS), and diagnosis of genetic disorders.

cards.stem: Which technique copies small segments of DNA?
cards.quote: Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) is a technique used to "amplify" small segments of DNA.
